notes.title: v0.4.1: Unlock Archer & Huge QoL Updates Are Here to Ease Your Pain!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! In this update, I focused on removing confusion about how many skills you need to cast to unlock certain features. I've also replaced the static stat screen with a live, dynamic one. Let me explain the details...

[list]
[*] First major change is Turn Orders! Yes, in battle you can see enemy turn order. No more guessing when the enemy will attack you.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41381663/a9748c3d95d383d5eb39088a880cb9c19cb4ba36.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] When you select a class or browse your character's page you can see their actual stats. Character page where you equip stuff have a better detailed stat sceen now.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41381663/aa83817069c651232bf7e13d7dc187d12f278734.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Skills now have a tracker that tells you how many times you've used your skill. It was annoying not knowing that information.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41381663/ead2723b0fdb0cf6fd876010aa9fb8b2fd0ea8c2.png[/img]

[b]Added Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] If you've defeated Bad Omen you can unlock Archer class.
[*] Pathway to Night now have a new stage called "First Night"
[*] 2 Achievements
[/list]

So, with those changes Castle Greyrot will have better clarity on giving their users information.

Until the next update, take care!

notes.title: A Long-Awaited Update – New Translation, Achievements & More!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, it's been a while... almost three years since my last update!

First off, I want to apologize to those who have been waiting for news from me. The past few years have been hectic—welcoming a child, multiple house relocations, changing jobs—life has kept me busy. But I'm happy to say that I can finally put some work into my project again!

Unfortunately, much of my development history has been lost over the years, so I can’t recall every fix I’ve made. However, this update marks the official start of the translation project, which I began in July 2022. Now, the entire game has been translated into Turkish!

In addition to the translation, I’ve added 10 new achievements related to game progression. If you load your save file, you’ll receive these achievements in the Stage Selection screen.

Thank you all for your patience! I’ll be back soon with new content, focusing on the "Redemption Hall" chapter of the game. Expect new unlockable heroes to work with.

Until then, take care!

notes.title: Our First Quality of Life Update is Here! v0.2.3 Changelog
notes.content:
[b]v0.2.3 Changelog[/b]

[list]
[*] Pressing F12 no longer opens up the console screen
[*] Pressing "Right Click" on Mouse now returns you to the previous screen on the menus
[*] There is a new button on the Class selection screen that acts as Quick Setup for entering Castle Greyrot (After you complete your first stage)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41381663/5c868c2f30fc888e5facff6f7f9897435824a723.png[/img]

[*] Added a new item "Retreat", which makes you quit the battle and return to the Castle... with Game Over!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41381663/56f74ecfae2f7f272e147ad4cc1414802192c718.png[/img]

[*] The default option for Synch Monitor is now ON, players who have 60+ FPS monitors should enable that.
[*] Disabled Keyboard input on Name Input screen in case of getting stuck on the screen.
[*] Selecting a stage no longer shows up the "Choose this stage?" question.
[*] On the Class selection screen, hovering over "Continue" and "Reset Choices" now shows up as a red icon
[/list]

notes.title: Castle Greyrot Now Available!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

We are proud to announce that we launched Castle Greyrot on Steam with more content than we ever wanted! Like in our previous post we want to share our Early Access progress.

[b]What will you find in the EA?[/b]

[list]
[*]20+ Bosses to fight (Let's round it to 30)
[*]2 Unlockable Characters
[*]The first story chapter is 100% completed that includes 20 stages
[*]There are some secret stages to be found, not gonna spoil that!
[*]The first 3 Character Focused Adventures and the first Extreme Battle are playable
[*]Equipment, Merchant, Chat System is implemented
[*]All core Steam features such as Steam Cloud and Achievements are implemented
[/list]

Enjoy our first version v0.2 Alpha! More content and quality of life features will implement as we develop! We can't wait to hear your precious feedback on our game!
